card.name: "Including" in antibiotic diarrhea warning
card.fires_on: The word "including" right after "nearly all antibacterial agents," in the C. difficile-associated diarrhea warning, just before the drug's own name. Weakly also "to" in "women exposed to AEDs".

modes.label: CDAD warning sentence
modes.description: "including" after "nearly all antibacterial agents," where the label then names its own drug.
